statement: Evaluate the AutoCAD dialect of AutoLISP, including its numbers, strings, symbols and lists, the standard special forms and control structures, and the list, arithmetic, string and number-conversion functions.
superiority: Compatible dialect with sandboxing, tracing and tail-call optimization.

acceptance.sketch: (foreach x '(1 2 3) ...) sums to 6; (rtos 3.14159 2 2) returns "3.14"; (mapcar '+ '(1 2) '(3 4)) = (4 6); (cond) with no true test returns nil.

notes: Verified against help page "About AutoLISP Basics (AutoLISP)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-F0E08704-2854-4E05-9096-3A3ACEA007EB ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-FC14467C-63B9-4400-8C6A-266D21C846AE ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-8543549B-F0D7-43CD-87A3-F6B827FF0B88 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers Lisp, LoadLisp; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Let LISP programs read, create, modify and delete drawing objects through entity names, DXF-group association lists and selection sets, using the entget, entmod, entmake, entupd, entdel, entnext, entlast, entsel, nentsel and ss* function families.

source.ref: About Using AutoLISP to Manipulate AutoCAD Objects

superiority: Same API with typed entity handles and transactions.

acceptance.sketch: (entget (car (entsel))) on a circle returns ((0 . "CIRCLE") (10 x y z) (40 . r) ...); entmod changes radius; entmake creates a LINE from ((0 . "LINE") (10 ..) (11 ..)).

notes: Verified against help page "About Using AutoLISP to Manipulate AutoCAD Objects (AutoLISP)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-B150646B-5F8F-460A-A5D6-AF7BD467B638 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-E0CCD0D3-AB95-40CE-A5DD-8E9214DC5469 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers Lisp; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Implement ssget with its documented selection-method strings (W, C, F, WP, CP, A, X, L, P, I) and option modifiers (:D, :E, :L, :N, :S), plus filter lists of DXF group codes with wildcard patterns, relational tests via -4 and logical grouping operators such as <AND.

acceptance.sketch: (ssget "X" '((0 . "CIRCLE")(40 . 5.0))) returns only circles r=5; (-4 . ">=") on 40 filters radius.

notes: Verified against help page "ssget (AutoLISP)". Corrected: Method strings carry no colon (W, C, F, WP, CP, X, L); colon-prefixed items are option modifiers, and the page lists L rather than _L. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-7BE77062-C359-4D01-915B-69CF672C653B ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-877CEEA5-0D88-48DF-8450-B9421031A1B7 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-5CB54129-22A1-42B9-B97C-2D2F5597F90E ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-11EA0ABD-AE29-4DD7-92A5-DFF6EC1C9799 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers SelectionFilter; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Query and modify symbol table entries (APPID, BLOCK, DIMSTYLE, LAYER, LTYPE, STYLE, UCS, VIEW, VPORT) and dictionary entries with tblsearch, tblnext, tblobjname, dictsearch, dictnext, dictadd and namedobjdict, while rejecting entdel on table entries and entmake of whole tables.

acceptance.sketch: (tblsearch "LAYER" "0") returns ((0 . "LAYER") ... (2 . "0") ...); tblnext iterates with T restart.

notes: Verified against help page "About Symbol Tables (AutoLISP)". Corrected: Table list needs VPORT; tables themselves cannot be created with entmake and entries cannot be deleted with entdel. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-2AEB84A6-E3D0-4DD9-A29C-54D4099ED925 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-24E52678-513E-4322-8070-B23C8945DC3D | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Provide the geometric utility functions distance, angle, polar, inters, osnap and textbox, together with trans for converting points and displacements between coordinate systems.

acceptance.sketch: (distance '(0 0 0) '(3 4 0)) = 5.0; (polar '(0 0 0) (/ pi 2) 5) = (0 5 0) within 1e-12; (inters p1 p2 p3 p4) returns intersection or nil.

notes: Verified against help page "Geometric Functions Reference (AutoLISP)". Corrected: The reference has no vector-function group; the geometric group is angle, distance, inters, osnap, polar and textbox, and trans belongs to the conversion functions. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-5BDBD4BC-289E-4A49-9BB9-DF6A6147E0FC ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-0F0B833D-78ED-4491-9918-9481793ED10B | prior app hint: cand2 app registers Calc; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

acceptance.sketch: (initget 1 "Yes No")(getkword "\nContinue? [Yes/No]") returns "Yes" on typing Y; (command "_.LINE" '(0 0) '(10 0) "") creates a line.

statement: Let defun c:name functions act as native commands typed at the Command prompt, usable transparently, callable from LISP as (c:name), able to redefine built-in commands, and taking their input through get functions rather than arguments.
superiority: Registered commands appear in search and macros.

acceptance.sketch: (defun c:Hello () (princ "Hi")(princ)) at the command line typing HELLO prints Hi; (defun f (/ a b) ...) localizes a,b.

notes: Verified against help page "About Defining Commands (AutoLISP)". Corrected: C: functions should not take arguments; local variables are declared after a slash.
